body:
R153's paid own-root floor is a valid proof source, but inserting its row into Native changes LP/AM inputs and can alter search. This adds the default-OFF research candidate **E**, which retains the base Native model and raw search/AM inputs and consumes the same floor through the scoped proof ledger. It also completes the signed state-product residual-pricing study on the full inherited Q.

The residual preserves signed costs, separate zero inventory, negative residual objectives, hard resources and Gupper. Its guarded residual lower converts to the original price with the correct denominator/sign case. The state-product block strengthens Cartesian aggregate McCormick; this is not a normalized-RN or complete-Q dominance theorem. Standard fractional parameterization and column generation retain their classical attribution.

| Domain | Complete hull interval (display rounded outward) | Columns / supports |
|---|---|---:|
| N-B35-S | [.39604305, .39604656] | 575 / 9 |
| K-35-U | [.28285969, .28732617] | 33896 / 90 |
| N-C20-U | [.18332184, .18986771] | 54235 / 63 |

K35 receives a 3600s strengthened price and eight updated full-pool tasks; NC20 receives eight updated tasks and a matched 600s interior-target comparison. Verified stocks reject the declared fixed proof targets, including the interior NC target. All new columns and supports are consumed, complete-free-Q support replays are completed, and the final columns receive qualified complete RMP refreshes. **K35/NC20 remain wider than 1e-4.** NC's upper decreases by 8.91e-5; there is no material new hull lower gain. A fixed-certificate ceiling is not a full-hull upper, and RMP uppers are LP-value bounds rather than routing incumbents. The finite recommendation is to pause this pricing branch and prioritize remaining routing/loading coupling.

All **nine frozen same-PE arms** use independent own-H, Seed0/Threads1 and the same unchanged floor producer:
- NB35 B/E have identical U=.450291503262878. E raises supported L from .38931060164210607 to .3959564087240911, reducing absolute gap by .006645807081985033.
- The same-PE NB35 J-row arm has essentially the same L but worse U=.46039474835411914. B/E AM records agree; J's floor row changes the parent/left inputs and first action. This does not isolate AM as the sole cause of the U difference.
- K35 and RB35 B/E endpoint bounds agree. NC20 B/E give the same certificate; E's certificate time is 1.788185s later. The floor is inactive at those three terminal bounds.
- E and J remain **research-only/default OFF**. Stable GI-TBC's original entry and profile remain unchanged; there is no instance-conditioned hybrid.

Validation includes the targeted interface/consumer qualifications, all nine actual closeouts, an independent final scientific ACCEPT, and a finite audit of 29 price records, 3 standalone fixed tasks plus 16 saved loop directions, five complete-free-Q support replays and all endpoint/identity/clock chains. The audit reads 37 Native models with **zero Optimize** calls. A separate independent three-point readback verifies the last lambda sets, actual solutions and true-stock marginal/completion arithmetic. Four failed outer attempts and exact source snapshots remain preserved.

Final G1 is **24588.354128699146 / 144000 seconds** (50 closed receipts plus the recorded .170762s diagnostic); compilation is **42.734852500027046s separately**. Nested Runtime/Work/H/helper is never charged again. Untimed setup/source-hash/history-bookkeeping gaps are disclosed.

Fixed science is **a1a3a8d1d88d0af35163e7f134bac09e1ad2077c**: 12 new-only carriers / 33178 members, with inherited R153 inputs/source/large carriers referenced by fixed commit/member hashes. One bounded anonymous recovery from this exact commit **passed all 140 manifest-listed files, 12 archives and 33178 members (3.18 GB) in 63.2436122s**. It downloaded no old carrier and ran no Native, Optimize, compiler or old producer. Post-PR bounded cleanup deleted **zero bytes**, retaining unique evidence, failures, required PE/DLL and the active tree. Actual receipts and the final publication state are recorded in the normal metadata follow-up commits.

- [Report](https://github.com/yifanXovo/TailoredExact/blob/a1a3a8d1d88d0af35163e7f134bac09e1ad2077c/results/unified_exact_round154/final_report.md), [mathematics](https://github.com/yifanXovo/TailoredExact/blob/a1a3a8d1d88d0af35163e7f134bac09e1ad2077c/results/unified_exact_round154/mathematical_analysis.md), [pricing](https://github.com/yifanXovo/TailoredExact/blob/a1a3a8d1d88d0af35163e7f134bac09e1ad2077c/results/unified_exact_round154/reports/pricing_results.csv), [hull table](https://github.com/yifanXovo/TailoredExact/blob/a1a3a8d1d88d0af35163e7f134bac09e1ad2077c/results/unified_exact_round154/reports/scientific_table.csv), [complete pairs](https://github.com/yifanXovo/TailoredExact/blob/a1a3a8d1d88d0af35163e7f134bac09e1ad2077c/results/unified_exact_round154/reports/complete_pairs.csv), [paper section](https://github.com/yifanXovo/TailoredExact/blob/a1a3a8d1d88d0af35163e7f134bac09e1ad2077c/results/unified_exact_round154/manuscript.tex).
- [Independent review](https://github.com/yifanXovo/TailoredExact/blob/a1a3a8d1d88d0af35163e7f134bac09e1ad2077c/results/unified_exact_round154/review/final_scientific_review.md), [costs](https://github.com/yifanXovo/TailoredExact/blob/a1a3a8d1d88d0af35163e7f134bac09e1ad2077c/results/unified_exact_round154/cost_report.json), [source identities](https://github.com/yifanXovo/TailoredExact/blob/a1a3a8d1d88d0af35163e7f134bac09e1ad2077c/results/unified_exact_round154/source_manifest.json), [recovery contract](https://github.com/yifanXovo/TailoredExact/blob/a1a3a8d1d88d0af35163e7f134bac09e1ad2077c/results/unified_exact_round154/reproducibility.md).
- [Actual publication/recovery/cleanup record](https://github.com/yifanXovo/TailoredExact/blob/codex/round154-target-pricing-proof-ledger/results/unified_exact_round154/RESUME.md).

The verified temporary base is codex/round153-coupled-objective-hull at ffcfb59899611cbefa1cfe0d739cba5f9b6e5fe5. Main remains b2b940c1e517a72e226ec60fc49ff19651737632; PR215 is Open Draft and unmerged. This PR is Draft, with no automatic merge, force push or branch deletion.
